race.comment: TREASURED LEGACY (14) has the right profile to take this out after being beaten only a length and a half in a 3YO Open at Belmont, with late interference adding merit to the run. She was an odds-on maiden winner the start before, is third-up, and Pike stays with the filly who looks well placed back from Saturday company. POLYVANOVA (2) appeals as the main danger with genuine 1400m credentials, a useful claim and a return to the trip that suits after fading over 1650m in a 3yo+ NMW1Y. Can sit handy from the outset and bounce back to her winning ways. STATE OF BOOM (3) rises from a maiden win at this track, but his late surge and proven track-and-distance record give him a solid case. VALANNE DAWN (8) can't be left out after winning last time out.
